paragraphs.text: Transforms DSH sidebar into a dual-column Codex interface with Activity Bar
# dsh-codex-rail
English  |  中文说明
## English
Transforms **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** into a sleek, immersive **Codex-style dual-column workspace**
with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, and smooth session history navigation.

> [!NOTE]
> **Author Disclaimer: This project is for personal use by the author and is a product of

vibecoding.**
> Crafted to bring a sleek, distraction-free, and immersive Codex dual-column workflow
to DeepSeek Harness. Feature evolution and maintenance are primarily tailored to the author's daily
workflow. Feedback, suggestions, and PRs are warmly welcomed!
### ✨ Key Features

- 🎨 **Unified Titlebar & Activity Rail**
Seamlessly fuses the native window titlebar with the 48px v
ertical Activity Rail, eliminating jarring borders, white gaps, and layout seams.

- 🗂️ **Codex Dual-Column Layout & Adaptive Popover Alignment**
- **48px Activity Rail**: Consolidate
s plugins, web browser, terminal, workspace switchers, and upstream DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 ~ rc.5, 0.2.2-alp
ha.2 ~ alpha.3, and 0.2.2-rc.1 More/Customization menus into a sleek vertical navigation column with

millisecond-precision popover docking;
- **Flexible Drawer Panel**: History sessions and side drawe

rs slide smoothly, maximizing your conversation and coding viewport;
- **Rich Codex Iconography**: N
ative dedicated SVG icons for Forge & Git Worktree (0.2.2-alpha.3 & 0.2.2-rc.1 Change Requests & Rev
iews), Patch & Changes Review (0.2.1-rc.5 Deliverables), LiveShare Collaboration (0.2.2-alpha.2 Shar
e action), Personalized Recommendations (Sparkle / 0.2.1-rc.4 icon), Runtime Stats & Inspector (0.2.
2-alpha.2 DevTools), Subagent OAR CLI, More Menus (Triple Dot), Skill Explorer, and Taskboard.

- 🧩 **DockKit Multi-Tab & Split Workspace Harmonization (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1)**
Full visual adaptation to
upstream DSH 0.2.2-rc.1's DockKit multi-tab docking subsystem (`[data-dockkit-*]`). Polishes tab st
rips, close buttons (with middle-click close support without jumping focus), split view dividers, an
d floating tool windows with minimalist rounded Codex aesthetics.

- 💬 **Quote Previews & Compact Reference Chips (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1)**
Seamlessly integrates DSH 0.2.2-rc
.1's quote insertion and compact quote previews (`[data-quote-preview]`, `[data-ref-chip]`) with sle
ek capsule styling, frosted glass popovers, and smooth removal animations in the composer input area
k capsule styling, frosted glass popovers, and smooth removal animations in the composer input area.

- 🛠️ **Forge Suite & Code Review Integration (DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3 & 0.2.2-rc.1)**

## 中文说明
将 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 界面重构为极具现代质感的 **Codex 式双列活动栏**与**全窗一体化**工作区主题插件。

> [!NOTE]
> **作者声明：此为作者自用且为 vibecoding 产物。**
> 本插件旨在为 DeepSeek Harness 打造精致沉浸的 Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验
。功能演变与日常维护主要依据作者个人实际工作流展开，欢迎交流体验与提交 PR！
### ✨ 核心特性

- 🎨 **全窗顶栏一体化质感**
无缝打通原生标题栏与 48px 活动栏（Activity Rail），彻底消除断层与多余留白，与原生明亮/暗黑主题深度贴合。

- 🗂️ **Codex 级双列工作流与自适应 Popover 锚定**
- **48px 图标活动栏**：将插件、终端、浏览器、工作区切换以及 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 ~ rc.5、0.2.2

-alpha.2 ~ alpha.3、0.2.2-rc.1 原生「更多/创建插件」菜单归拢于左侧纵向 Rail，毫秒级浮层对齐，布局井然有序；
- **弹性会话面板**：侧边列表支持平滑收展，留出最大

化的主对话与编码视野；
- **全套 Codex 专属图标**：深度适配 Forge 代码审查与 Git 工作树（0.2.2-alpha.3 & 0.2.2-rc.1 Change Requests
/ PR 审查）、补丁应用与变更检视（0.2.1-rc.5 apply_patch / 交付物审核）、LiveShare 协作共享（0.2.2-alpha.2 实时协作）、个性化推荐（0.2.1-rc
.4 官方灵感徽标 / Sparkle）、开发者工具与运行统计（0.2.2-alpha.2 Stats）、Subagent OAR 协同、更多菜单（三点水平排列）、技能探索与看板等专属矢量图形。

- 🧩 **DockKit 多标签面板系统与右侧分栏适配 (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1)**
全量深度适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 全新引入的 DockKit 标签页与分栏拖拽体系（`[dat
a-dockkit-*]`）。重绘 DockKit 顶部标签栏（Strip）、标签项悬浮与激活态、平滑中键快速关闭标签页、分割控制柄与独立浮动窗（Float Window），呈现纯正 Codex 轻量

- 💬 **输入框引用与紧凑预览胶囊卡片 (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1)**
完美契合 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 引用文本插入与紧凑预览特性（`[data-quote-preview]` / `
